summary: UCB has two official campus housing providers: Campus Company and Schneider Bau. Apply several months before your semester starts — rooms fill quickly. The most important distinction before signing any lease is Kaltmiete vs. Warmmiete: cold rent is just the base rent, warm rent includes utilities (Nebenkosten). Always confirm which figure you are agreeing to.

concepts.title: Kaltmiete vs. Warmmiete
concepts.body: Kaltmiete is the base (cold) rent — it does not include heating, electricity, water, or building maintenance costs. Warmmiete includes all of these (Nebenkosten = additional costs). When comparing flats, always compare Warmmiete figures. Many students are surprised when their first utility bill arrives — this explanation prevents that.

concepts.title: Campus Company & Schneider Bau
concepts.body: These are the two official housing providers on or near the UCB campus. They offer furnished rooms specifically for students. Apply as early as possible — rooms are limited and demand is high at semester start. Contact them directly via the links below.

concepts.title: Studierendenwerk Trier
concepts.body: The Studierendenwerk (student services organisation) covers UCB and offers an alternative route for student housing applications. Worth applying to in parallel with campus providers to maximise your chances.

concepts.title: WG-Gesucht (Flatshares)
concepts.body: WG-Gesucht is Germany's largest shared flat (Wohngemeinschaft / WG) portal. If campus housing is unavailable, this is the standard tool students use. Writing a short introduction letter in German significantly improves response rates from landlords.
